comment: The product's name and identity, in one place. CMake reads this file (cmake/Branding.cmake) and generates brand.hpp for the code; change a value here and rebuild. This app (AGPL-3.0-or-later) is based on MitCad (MIT licence): upstreamName is the name the MitCad code and its texts use, swapped for displayName in the interface at run time.
